window_selection_rule.source_ym_note: Rows are selected strictly by UTC settlement timestamp window, NOT filtered by source_ym. Both original funding_time_ms and ts_snapped_ms are preserved side-by-side.

columns_and_units.inst_id: OKX USDT-margined perpetual swap instrument ID (string)
columns_and_units.funding_time_ms: Original OKX fundingTime in Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC)
columns_and_units.funding_time_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp derived from funding_time_ms (millisecond precision)
columns_and_units.ts_snapped_ms: Grid-snapped settlement timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC); unchanged from raw when outside snap tolerance
columns_and_units.ts_snapped_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp derived from ts_snapped_ms
columns_and_units.funding_rate: Per-settlement funding rate as decimal (e.g. 0.0001 = 0.01% = 1 bps)
columns_and_units.source_ym: Origin archive month tag (YYYY-MM) or 'l1_backfill' for public REST backfill

gap_and_dedup_policy.missing_8h_handling: Missing 8H grid events are recorded as miss_8h, NOT zero-filled, NOT interpolated, and NOT excluded from position holding.
gap_and_dedup_policy.next_batch_note: After this time-normalized + non-8H + miss_8h shard is verified, remaining shards (including 2025-2026 1H/4H mixed-frequency shards such as FLOW-USDT-SWAP 2026-01) and actual held-position funding roster coverage will follow.
